note: MDC grassland and savanna area west of Salem on the Cherokee Trail of Tears' northern route. The one designated camping area is open savanna on the north side of Dent County Road 253, between a small gravel lot and the area headquarters yard: grass under scattered oaks reached by a two-track, with no pads, tables or water. A privy is at the headquarters lot. Field trials are held here by permit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one designated camping area (map symbol + GIS point) - an open grass savanna patch beside the headquarters, not a lot, padless. Privy written from the map. No horse camp. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands. Pin fine. Phone matches.
flags: DESIGNATED POINT: page lists 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted on spots designated on the area map.' The 3/13/2019 map legend has 'Primitive Camping' and draws one symbol, beside the Privy, Disabled Accessible, Parking Lot and MDC Office symbols in the middle of the area; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 37.62454,-91.72769 (the stored pin).

WHAT IS ON THE GROUND: the point is in an open grassy patch about 40 x 60 m under scattered oaks, 15 m north of the county road, with a faint two-track running through it from the west; no gravel pads. A gravel lot about 12 x 15 m is across the road 70 m west and the headquarters' gravel yard (shop building, equipment) is 80 m east. So it is a padless grass area rather than a lot - kept with that said in the note. Not a lot-rule case.

HORSE / FIELD TRIAL: no horse camp. Brochure: 'Horseback riding allowed on roads open to' vehicles; field trials 'only by special use permit' (page Rule 125). The camping area is the only one and is general.
PRIVY: the map draws a Privy symbol beside the camping symbol at the headquarters lot; a small structure is visible at the west edge of that lot on imagery. vault_toilets written from the map.
ACCESS: Dent County Road 253 (gravel county road, shown as 2530 on the map) runs through the area past the camp; no ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording.
WATERFRONT - NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: only small ponds on the area, the nearest 250 m off in the savanna.
PIN: stored pin = GIS point, in the grass camping patch. No move.
PHONE: stored 573-368-2225 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 368-2225'.
No split (one camping point). Nothing else in the database within 3 km.
